reviews.text: If I could give more stars, I would, and they're all deserved. Bonnie and I ended up here by chance. We needed a fairly quick ultrasound, and they found me a same-day appointment. From there, they had the perseverance and professionalism to guide us through a difficult journey, filled with emergencies, visits, therapies, day hospitalizations... and so much patience! The diagnosis was clear, our time was short, and I just wanted it to be good. You've given us wonderful months, and I'll always be grateful. All the doctors at the clinic examined Bonnie and were impeccable in their work. Thank you to all the staff, the reception, the nurses, and the doctors: empathetic professionals with a great sense of humanity.

Don't listen to everyone who writes "positive experience", "they treat animals well", etc. I took my dog ​​there and this was the experience: I brought him when he was sick, he should have been hospitalized some time ago, but he was regularly treated with a medicine that made him feel better, which I don't want to specify. The totally incompetent nurse didn't even know where he was when she had to administer the medicine, it looked like he'd been there for 3 hours, and my dog ​​wasn't dangerous, on the contrary; rather than the doctor, who rather than trying to find a solution, the only thing she could say was "bring him here, I'll see, I'll see...". My question is why people who aren't capable of caring for animals choose this job; it takes patience, care, attention, sensitivity, all characteristics that 98% of those who work there lack. My dog ​​is no longer there. The only thing I hope for myself is to never find another one of those people on the street.

I brought my dog ​​in on a Saturday afternoon for an emergency, searching online for a nearby center that was open. The experience was absolutely positive: I called close to closing time, yet they were kind and invited me to bring him. As soon as they arrived, my dog ​​was immediately examined by an extremely thorough and competent doctor. With a thorough examination, he made the right diagnosis (which wasn't what one might think from the symptoms) and developed the right treatment plan. By that evening, my dog ​​was already feeling much better! All at absolutely fair prices. Thank you for your hospitality and professionalism! ❤️

I arrived today at the Castel Verde clinic with my dog ​​in an unpleasant situation. I was welcomed without an appointment by Dr. Augusto Zara and I found him to be a competent and very professional doctor. I thank him from the bottom of my heart.

Our rabbit had been in your care for 6 years. During this time, we had check-ups approximately every 6 months and were always told that the animal was fine, healthy, and had no medical conditions requiring treatment.
One day, the rabbit felt ill. We rushed her to another veterinary emergency room, where she unfortunately died. There, we were informed that the animal was suffering from serious uterine and lung problems, had two kidney stones, and was underweight.

We were never told of any of these issues during check-ups. In fact, we were always told that the rabbit was in good health.

Review of the Augusto Zara Veterinary Clinic – Castel Verde, Rome
My cat, Zeus, underwent emergency surgery for intestinal intussusception at another facility. Unfortunately, the post-op was not managed properly: early discharge, ineffective antibiotic therapy, and undiagnosed IV extravasation resulting in extensive infection of the limb.
I consulted Dr. Augusto Zara, who immediately assessed the case. He prescribed targeted antibiotic therapy and medications for drainage, anti-inflammatories, and intestinal support. He provided a detailed home treatment plan, even on a Sunday.
Result: After 15 critical days, Zeus has resumed eating, regular bowel movements, and mobility. His leg is on the road to complete recovery.

Thank you so much, Dr. Zara. Zeus and I owe you everything. 🐾❤️

A truly positive experience; I found both the medical and reception staff to be extremely professional.
Dr. Bonaiuti avoided surgery for a foxtail lodged in my dog's side, about 1 cm deep.
She managed to locate and extract it by re-entering through the entry wound.
Thanks to everyone at the clinic for their professionalism, but above all for their kindness and patience.
Thank you so much, Dr. Bonaiuti.

If I could, I'd give them 10 stars for how great they were. My 15-year-old cat had a sarcoma on his lower left leg that had grown out of control. Unfortunately, the only way to save him was to amputate the leg. We put ourselves in the hands of the doctors and surgeons at the clinic, and Silvestro had a perfect operation. The scar was immediately clean and free of smudges. They cared for the cat throughout his hospital stay, and they were always available to offer advice and support for any problems. After two weeks, Silvestro finally had his stitches removed and is walking around the house happily on his three legs. He's doing great, and it's all thanks to you and your expertise. Thank you so much.
Wonderful clinic, excellent and very kind doctors.

I hope they shut you down because you're not worthy of working with animals or their owners!!! Be thankful that I'm a far superior person; otherwise, no one would have taken away your complaint!!!

I brought my Labrador for an emergency. I was truly impressed by the professionalism and, above all, the kindness of the staff. The girls were attentive, patient, and very affectionate with him, making him feel at ease right away. You can tell how much they care about the animals' well-being and how much they put their heart into what they do. I highly recommend this clinic!

An infinite thank you to Augusto, who has supported and put up with us over the years with infinite professionalism. It is with infinite respect and affection that we extend our heartfelt thanks to a great doctor and a great man. Anna F.

Super positive experience. I took my cat to this veterinary center for the first time about a month and a half ago after she was hit by a car and her paw was in really critical condition. Today they removed the bandage for the first time, and when I saw her paw, I couldn't believe it was healed. I highly recommend this center!
